## Automated AI review

> **Community review:** Independent automated community review, unaffiliated with the Omarchy team, intended to help prepare PRs for their review.

One functional gap found: `omarchy-theme-bg-prev` skips video backgrounds. Two smaller notes follow, on the vantablack icon name and on theme cycling when `omarchy-theme-set` rejects a theme.

**Verified:** each new or changed test (`theme-dark-icons`, `theme-next`, `theme-bg-prev`, `show-logo`, `menu-test`) fails on the base with the head's test files copied in, and passes on the head and on the head merged into the current `quattro` tip. The PR merges onto that tip without conflicts. The tip's `run_parallel` still uses `bash -lc`, so the `--noprofile --norc` change still applies there. `omarchy theme next`, `omarchy theme prev` and `omarchy theme bg prev` resolve through the CLI, and `omarchy commands --check` passes. 15 of the 16 new `Yaru-*-dark` names exist in the packaged `yaru-icon-theme`, and every changed theme declares `mode = "dark"`.

### `omarchy-theme-bg-prev` skips video backgrounds

`omarchy-theme-bg-prev` collects only `jpg jpeg png gif bmp webp`. `omarchy-theme-bg-next`, `omarchy-theme-set` and `omarchy-theme-bg-set` also accept `mp4 m4v mov webm mkv avi` since video wallpaper support was added.

Synthetic run with backgrounds `1-a.png 2-m.mp4 3-z.png` (setters stubbed):

```text
bg-next from 1-a.png : 2-m.mp4 → 3-z.png → 1-a.png
bg-prev from 3-z.png : 1-a.png → 3-z.png → 1-a.png   (never reaches 2-m.mp4)
bg-prev from 2-m.mp4 : 3-z.png → 1-a.png → 3-z.png   (expected 1-a.png first)
```

**Impact:** with a video among a theme's backgrounds, "previous" never selects it. When a video is current, "previous" jumps to the last still image. A theme with only videos reports "No background was found for theme" on previous while next works.

**Suggested change:** use the same extension list as `omarchy-theme-bg-next` (ideally one shared definition) and add a video case to `theme-bg-prev-test.sh`.

### `vantablack` names an icon theme that is not shipped

`themes/vantablack/icons.theme` changes from `Yaru-gray` to `Yaru-gray-dark`. Neither name exists in `yaru-icon-theme` as packaged for Omarchy (26.04.5.1ubuntu-1 on stable/rc, 26.10.3-2 on edge). Those packages ship `Yaru-{blue,magenta,olive,prussiangreen,purple,red,sage,wartybrown,yellow}` and `Yaru`, each with a `-dark` twin, and no gray variant.

**Impact:** not a regression: GTK falls back to hicolor for vantablack before and after this PR. The PR's goal of a dark Yaru set is not reached for this theme, and `theme-dark-icons-test.sh` only checks the `-dark` suffix, so it passes regardless.

**Suggested change:** pick an existing dark set for vantablack (for example `Yaru-dark`; the colour choice is a maintainer call), or have the test also check names against the shipped set.

### Theme cycling repeats a theme that `omarchy-theme-set` rejects

`omarchy-theme-next` and `omarchy-theme-prev` always send the notification after calling `omarchy-theme-set`. Their candidate list (the same union as `omarchy-theme-list`) can include entries that `omarchy-theme-set` rejects: hidden directories, hand-made mixed-case directories, and broken user symlinks.

**Impact:** for such an entry the notification names a theme that was not applied, `theme.name` stays unchanged, and the next press targets the same entry again, so cycling cannot move past it. Rare in practice, since `omarchy-theme-install` produces lowercase names.

**Suggested change:** check the exit status of `omarchy-theme-set` (notify the failure or skip to the following candidate), or filter candidates to names it accepts. Passing the slug directly to `omarchy-theme-set`, which the scripts' own comment says it accepts, also avoids the unquoted `parts=($slug)` split. That split pathname-expands theme names containing `*`, `?` or `[` when matching files exist in the working directory.
